### The Issue

The `CS0117` build error occurs because recent versions of the `Testcontainers` NuGet package removed the static `TestcontainersSettings.Logger` property. Logging configuration has been moved away from global settings and is now handled on a per-container basis via the builder API.

### The Fix

To resolve this, you need to remove the static logger assignments and instead use the `.WithLogger()` extension method directly on your `PostgreSqlBuilder` instances.

**1. Update `PostgreSqlFixture.cs**`
In `MyRestaurant.DataAccess.Tests/PostgreSqlFixture.cs`, remove the `TestcontainersSettings.Logger = NullLogger.Instance;` assignment. Update your builder to look like this:

```csharp
_container = new PostgreSqlBuilder(PostgreSqlImage)
    .WithDatabase("myrestaurant")
    .WithUsername("myrestaurant")
    .WithPassword("myrestaurant")
    .WithLogger(NullLogger.Instance)
    .Build();

```

**2. Update `RestaurantHarness.cs**`
Similarly, in `MyRestaurant.EndToEnd.Tests/Harness/RestaurantHarness.cs`, remove the `TestcontainersSettings.Logger = NullLogger.Instance;` assignment and update the builder chain:

```csharp
_container = new PostgreSqlBuilder(PostgreSqlImage)
    .WithDatabase("postgres")
    .WithUsername("myrestaurant")
    .WithPassword("myrestaurant")
    .WithLogger(NullLogger.Instance)
    .Build();

```

Once you move `NullLogger.Instance` into the builder configuration for both files, your tests will compile successfully.
